counting_basis: One row per key. A state votes a scheme's revenue head and its capital head separately and both are separate rows here, exactly as they are separate rows in the register.

known_errors.why: Marunthagam is Tamil for pharmacy and no rule knows the word. The department is Co-operation, which runs the shops, so the department signal actively misleads. A one-word rule for one row would be over-fitting, so it is left wrong.

known_errors.row: Transportation of deceased Non Resident Tamils / Repatriation of Tamil Nationals in distress/ medical invalidation (Tamil Nadu, 2235)
known_errors.why: The ordinary-word trap this repository keeps finding. The benefit is repatriation; the word 'medical' appears only in the phrase 'medical invalidation', naming a reason a worker is sent home.

Civil services coaching for Scheduled Caste students. The name is a coined word, the head is SC welfare and the department is Social Welfare, so every signal points at the beneficiary group and none at the benefit.

known_errors.row: Power Cost subsidy to Saloons (Andhra Pradesh, 2225)
known_errors.why: A trade subsidy filed by the Backward Classes Welfare Department. Reading 'power' as Utility & Sanitation was worse: it broke 'Free power to Weavers' and 'Subsidy for free Power to Irrigation Pumpsets' as well.
Income support to advocates, filed under Administration of Justice. Both readings are defensible and the head agrees with the wrong one.

known_errors.row: Jan Shikshan Sansthan (central, no demand number)
known_errors.why: A vocational institute whose name contains the word for education.

known_errors.row: Establishment of Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence for Education (central, Department of Higher Education)
known_errors.why: Genuinely both. The name carries a Science, IT & Communications phrase and an Education & Learning one, and the ordering prefers the first.

known_errors.row: Unspent SCSP-TSP Amount as per the SCSP-TSP Act 2013 (Karnataka, 2225 and 2851)
known_errors.why: One of the rows no sector fits. The classifier has no way to know that and reads whatever the purpose line happens to mention. 312 rows abstain for want of any confident signal; rows like this one have a signal and it is noise.

known_errors_audit_2.pattern: a coined brand name that means the opposite of what it looks like
rows: Thallikivandanam (Andhra Pradesh) is a payment to mothers to keep a child in school, so Education & Learning; assigned Social welfare & Empowerment from the department
Ganga Kalyana - for Schedule Tribe (Karnataka, 2225) is borewells for farmers, so Agriculture,Rural & Environment; assigned Social welfare & Empowerment because 'kalyana' is in the welfare pattern
known_errors_audit_2.why: No signal in the row disagrees with the wrong answer. This is the residual the name signal cannot reach.

known_errors_audit_2.pattern: the bare word 'nutrition' falls through to Health & Wellness
rows: National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (Kerala, 2401) is Agriculture,Rural & Environment
Ensure Nutrition Scheme - Uttasathai Uruthi Sei (Tamil Nadu, 2236) is Women and Child
known_errors_audit_2.why: Women and Child catches the named nutrition programmes and Health & Wellness catches whatever is left, which is wrong in both directions. The word needs to be dropped from Health & Wellness, not moved.

rows: Psycho Social Programme for Orphaned Mentally Ill Persons (Kerala, 2235) is Health & Wellness, not Women and Child
known_errors_audit_2.why: The same ordinary-word failure as the rest, one level up: the word is right and the inference from it is not.

known_errors_audit_2.pattern: a topic word decides a row whose subject is elsewhere in the name
rows: Dr. Ambedkar Village Development Scheme (Kerala, 2225 and 4225) read 'village' and answered Agriculture,Rural & Environment
Silk Samagra-Central Share Rural Development (Kerala, 2515) read 'rural development' and answered Agriculture,Rural & Environment; silk is Business & Entrepreneurship
known_errors_audit_2.why: The topic-word tier measured 0.840 and these are what the other 0.160 look like.

known_errors_audit_2.pattern: a welfare department paying a student benefit, with nothing in the name to say so
rows: Prize Money Award Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students (Tamil Nadu, 2225)
Free supply of Bicycles to Backward Classes Girls Students (Tamil Nadu, 2225)
Free Supply of Uniform to Students (Tamil Nadu, 2235, Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department)
known_errors_audit_2.why: The single biggest failure mode in the whole file and the one the docstring opens with. All three are Education & Learning and all three were assigned Social welfare & Empowerment by the department. The name carries the word 'Students' but not a benefit phrase, so the topic-word tier ties with the department at 2 points each and the tie is broken alphabetically, which is not a reason. Giving the topic word 3 points would fix all three and has to be measured against what it breaks.

known_errors_audit_2.pattern: the ministry owns the commodity but not the sector
rows: Spices Board (Department of Commerce) is Agriculture,Rural & Environment, not Business & Entrepreneurship
Price Stabilisation Fund (Department of Consumer Affairs) is Agriculture,Rural & Environment, not Public Safety,Law & Justice
Training/Human Resource Development (Ministry of Railways) is Skills & Employment, not Transport & Infrastructure
known_errors_audit_2.why: Exactly the 0.720 the department signal measured, seen from the inside.

known_errors_audit_2.pattern: a budget line no sector fits, given one anyway
rows: Additional Amount met from Reserve fund (Ministry of Petroleum)
Payment to ISPRL for Crude Oil Reserve (Ministry of Petroleum)
International Relations (Ministry of New and Renewable Energy)
Computerisation (Ministry of Railways)
known_errors_audit_2.why: The register carries these rows because the Budget prints them, and the department is the only thing they have. Nothing here can tell a scheme from an office expense; parse/classify_*.py can, and wiring their verdict in as a gate is the obvious next move for the central rows.

known_errors_audit_2.pattern: the delivery agency rather than the benefit
rows: Stree Shakti Scheme - providing Free Bus Travel for Women (Andhra Pradesh, Public Transport Department) is Social welfare & Empowerment
Insurance coverage for Anganwadi workers and helpers (Kerala, 2235) is about the worker, not the child
known_errors_audit_2.why: A free bus pass is booked to the transport corporation that loses the fare, and the department signal reads the corporation.

known_errors_audit_2.pattern: an employer obligation read as the benefit it resembles
rows: Payment of Medical Reimbursement Charges to Retired All India Service Officers (Tamil Nadu, 2071) is Social welfare & Empowerment by the same rule that puts every other 2071 pension row there
known_errors_audit_2.why: 'medical' outranks the pension rule here because the pension rule needs the word pension and this row says 'Retired'.

rows: Aqua Produce Processing (Fish and Shrimp), Interest Subsidy for Crop Loan, Fast Reactor Fuel Cycle Projects, Other Disaster Management Schemes and 'Residential' were each counted against the classifier in audit 2 on a strict reading, and each has a defensible second answer
known_errors_audit_2.why: Recorded so the 0.860 is read as a floor rather than a point estimate.

myscheme_department_ceiling.why: A ceiling for any department-only rule, measured on myScheme's own records with its own answers in hand. A department is not a sector.

operating_point.why: Chosen for usefulness, not for safety. A wrong sector is a browsing annoyance, not a false accusation, so this file does not run at the 0.95 precision bar the scheme-or-not classifiers in this directory use. It still abstains where nothing but one weak signal fires, because a wrong sector is worse than a missing one for a reader filtering by it.

question: Which of the 15 myScheme sectors does each register row belong to, for the rows myScheme does not list and which therefore carry no sector of their own?
scope: The 680 registry entries with no myScheme source, plus every state classification row at or above site/build.py's listing bar that myScheme does not list. A superset of what the site shows by 366 centrally sponsored state shares that site/build.py folds into their parent scheme.

signals_rejected.measured: 0.444 over the 45 hand-labelled Kerala rows where it fires, against 0.865 for the name; and once the name, department and head are in place it was the deciding signal on 1 row in 2,599
signals_rejected.signal: Kerala's own sector string, its 36 values mapped onto the 15
signals_rejected.why: Kerala's axis is WHO the money is for and myScheme's is WHAT it buys. Kerala's largest bucket, 'Welfare of SCs, STs, OBCs, Minorities and Forward', is mostly scholarships, which the shared vocabulary files under Education & Learning, so the mapping fails hardest exactly where Kerala files most of its schemes. Merging the two vocabularies into the filter was never an option; using one to predict the other does not work either.

signals_rejected.measured: 74 values, none of them a sector
signals_rejected.signal: the Union Budget demand number, used as a category
signals_rejected.why: It identifies a ministry, so it is resolved to the ministry name the Budget prints beside it and fed to the department rules instead.

signals_rejected.measured: 'more' 0.93 Agriculture over 15 records, 'system' 0.88, 'area' 0.84, 'post' 0.80 Education, 'old' 0.84 Social welfare, all on myScheme's 4,771 names
signals_rejected.signal: bare common words with high measured lift on myScheme's names
signals_rejected.why: Every one is a fragment of another word or of a brand. Two got into an early version and both were caught: '\bhouse\b' filed 'National Test House' as Housing & Shelter, '\bscience\b' filed 'Government Arts and Science College' as Science, IT & Communications. Every pattern here is a phrase naming a benefit or a domain.

signals_rejected.measured: 0.650 over the 60 rows of audit 1 where it decided
signals_rejected.signal: the department alone, where nothing else fires
signals_rejected.why: Not rejected but capped: it scores 2, so it publishes only when a second signal agrees with it. On its own it is a coin weighted two-to-one, which is not good enough to put in front of a reader.

taxonomy_source: data/checks.json, the sector myScheme sets on all 4,771 of its records. Not extended, not merged with Kerala's own 36 values: one filter, one vocabulary.

validation.audit_note: Both audits are hand readings of the classifier's own published answer, drawn stratified by DECIDING SIGNAL so that each signal's precision is a count. Audit 1 was read against the first working version and its findings WERE fed back: eight pattern defects it exposed are fixed and each is commented at the pattern. Audit 2 is disjoint from audit 1 and from the stratified sample, was read against the shipped version and was NOT fed back. Quote audit 2.

hand_sample.note: Accuracy on a stratified sample of the population. The audits below count errors on the published answers instead.

rows_no_sector_fits.note: 10 of the 320 hand-labelled rows are budget lines no sector fits ('Actual Recoveries', 'Mauritius', 'Other works') and 9 could not be settled from the row's own evidence. They are out of the accuracy figure and counted here instead, because a classifier that files 'Onetime payment of Arrears.' under a sector is wrong in a way accuracy hides.
